title: Jonah and the Escarpment
author: Coral Galloway
blurb: Cyrus Sandoval, a bush pilot flying medicine and rumors into the interior, has spent three years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
